description: Expected static UI strings per language, checked by tests/smoke/run-smoke.mjs right after startup. Keys are CSS selectors (textContent) or 'selector@attribute'. Values mirror src/renderer/i18n.ts; state-dependent texts (status, Connect button, sidebar counts, selection controls, move preview, the AP groups / Wi-Fi networks lists and details, the Back label once a link is followed) are checked separately. At startup no controller data is loaded, so the destination list, the sidebar entry and the AP groups view title show the Omada 6.3+ vocabulary ('Grupos de AP' / 'AP groups'), the move button reads the neutral 'Mover AP' / 'Move APs' (nothing to move), and the hidden Back button reads 'Volver' / 'Back'.

en.#destinationSearch@aria-label: Search destination groups or Wi-Fi networks
en.#settingsModalMessage: The controller connection, the language, the optional management access and the optional TP-Link cloud access. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
en.#groupNameHint: 1 to 128 characters, different from every other group's name (ignoring case).
en.#siteModalMessage: This controller manages several sites. Choose which one to manage:
en.#certCloudNote: TP-Link cloud controllers are reached through TP-Link's cloud: their certificate is verified normally, with no pinning and no prompt.
en.#managementHelp: Lets the app manage AP groups and Wi-Fi networks. Create an Open API application in the controller's settings, in client credentials mode, and copy its Client ID and Client Secret here.
en.#managementSessionNote: This computer cannot store the Client Secret securely: it is kept only until you quit the app, and you will need to enter it again next time.
en.#managementRemovalNote: Management access will be removed when you save.
en.#managementRemoveMessage: Remove management access? The Client ID and the Client Secret are deleted when you save.
en.#cloudHelp: Lets the app reach your remote Omada controllers through your TP-Link cloud account.
en.#cloudCredentialHelp: Create the credential in the TP-Link Omada cloud portal: On Premise Systems → Open API (Account Level Open API), in client credentials mode, and copy its Client ID and Client Secret here. Changes need full access; with view-only access the data can only be viewed. If that page is missing, TP-Link has not enabled it for your account yet.
en.#cloudSessionNote: This computer cannot store the cloud Client Secret securely: it is kept only until you quit the app, and you will need to enter it again next time.
en.#cloudRemovalNote: Cloud access will be removed when you save.
en.#cloudRemoveMessage: Remove cloud access? The region, the Client ID and the Client Secret are deleted when you save, and the local controller becomes the active one again.
en.#groupSearch@aria-label: Search groups by name or Wi-Fi network
en.#networkSearch@aria-label: Search Wi-Fi networks by name or group
